title: Zesty Egyptian Chickpeas Tagine
description: A velvety, wine-infused chickpea tagine brimming with cardamom and aromatic spices, perfect for a kid-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a tagine or heavy saucepan over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix in ground cardamom, cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika and sauté for 30 seconds to bloom the spices.
Add chickpeas, tomato paste, and honey, stirring to coat the beans evenly.
Pour in red wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add vegetable broth, bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then cover and let it cook for 20 minutes until flavors meld.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, stirring gently.
Remove the tagine from heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot over couscous or rice.
